description: Looks up a browser game on Foundplay by its play link, Foundplay page link or slug. Says whether it's listed, and if so its page, public play and upvote counts, whether its link works, whether its maker has claimed it, and whether it can be boosted, with the links to claim or boost it. If it isn't listed, gives the free link that lists it. Read-only.

game.description: The game's play link (where people play it), its Foundplay page link, or its Foundplay slug.

name: check_game
title: Check a game on Foundplay
